fieldNotes.truckGate: Sliding iron gate across the NE 87th Ave entrance into the parking/yard, plus a gated dock driveway to the south dock apron. Whole site fenced with tall iron perimeter fence.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth structure at either gate.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Main NE 87th Ave gate has a call-box/intercom post beside it and no guard shack - remote/kiosk check-in.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Reefer (refrigerated) trailers backed into dock doors on the SW/south building face, seen in May/Jul 2025 Street View; additional dock positions along the east face by the bulk silos. ~12 total estimated - low confidence.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Paved trailer-staging yard north/NE of the building holds parked trailers separate from active docks.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail track curves along the east/NE edge of the property, but it appears to be a through-siding on/along the adjacent parcel - no rail dock spur visibly entering the YoCream building. Marked false, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.truckGateCount: Counted the NE 87th Ave parking gate plus the separate gated south dock driveway.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: NE Portland industrial district near the airport - Urban.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Estimated from perimeter box; tight urban parcel ~6 acres including building and yard.
